study.title: Minimizing Human-Induced Variability in Quantitative Angiography for Robust and Explainable AI-Based Occlusion Prediction

imaging.modality_detail: Dynamic DSA sequences at pre-treatment, post-treatment and follow-up; 2D quantitative angiography from time density curves
imaging.territory_detail: Intracranial aneurysms treated with flow diverters

annotation.annotator_expertise: Occlusion outcome by neurosurgeons from follow-up DSA; ROIs drawn by neurosurgeon fellows and residents with 2 years of neuro-intervention experience

task.task_description: SVD-based deconvolution of the aneurysm time density curve by the parent artery input and reconvolution with a standardized injection curve to remove injection bias from QA parameters, followed by a DNN predicting six-month occlusion of flow-diverter-treated intracranial aneurysms, with LIME explanations.
task.clinical_application: Prognosis of six-month occlusion after flow diverter treatment of intracranial aneurysms; intraoperative decision support

temporal_evidence.quote: we reconvolved the IRF with a standardized injection profile to obtain a clinically relevant and injection-invariant TDC (Qnew) of the IA dome

metrics.metric: Accuracy (relative SVD-corrected QA parameters, all features incl. AUC-0.5 to AUC-2.0)
Accuracy (relative SVD-corrected QA parameters, six-feature set Cor, TTP, MTT, PH, AUC, Max-Gr)

comparators: DNN trained on uncorrected (no-SVD) QA parameters
DNN trained on single QA parameters
Pre-treatment and post-treatment only feature sets

G1.quote: our study was limited by the relatively small sample size, single-center retrospective data collection and self-adjudicated outcomes

G2.quote: Further large-scale study across multiple institutions would enhance the robustness of the DNN

G4.quote: One of the limitations of this study is foreshortening due to the 2D nature of the imaging system

G6.quote: single-center retrospective data collection and self-adjudicated outcomes

G7.quote: Local Interpretable Model-Agnostic Explanations (LIME) identified the key imaging features influencing the model, ensuring transparency and clinical relevance.

G8.quote: patient demographic and clinical characteristics that may influence treatment outcomes were not incorporated into our model

G11.quote: A deep neural network (DNN) trained on these QA-derived biomarkers predicted six-month occlusion.

other_limitations: Inference preprocessing inconsistent with training could make LIME explanations misleading
future_work: 3D QA methods to eliminate foreshortening errors
Pre-procedural planning and device sizing by simulating device configurations
